answer: Lantern-renewed bond decay: each identity locks a 100-credit bond losing 10 credits per idle epoch. Its sparrow courier must file a velvet-sealed renewal, identity-signed, at the lantern post before the epoch closes. Auditors check the velvet seal; a stale or borrowed one burns the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 12,000 per epoch in renewals, or 10,000 lost to decay. An honest agent pays one 12-credit renewal; a rented sparrow cannot forge the seal.
